title: Multiplatform Plutus Script Cost & Evaluation Library (JS/JVM/LLVM)

ms.promise:
UPLC script execution cost calculation implementation for JVM, JavaScript platforms in Scalus.
A library for script execution and cost calculation.
Unit and/or property tests.
Documentation for the API.
Changelog.md and Readme.md files updated with details on what was implemented and how to use it
ms.criteria:
The library can perform script execution and script execution cost calculation according to PlutusV2 specs.
There are unit and/or property tests that cover that functionality.
Source code API are documented.
Changelog.md and Readme.md files are updated with details on what was implemented and how to use it.
ms.report:
Script Execution
Here is a multiplatform implementation of Plutus CEK machine:
https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.2/shared/src/main/scala/scalus/uplc/eval/Cek.scala
Plutus v1/v2 builtins
Plutus v1/v2 builtins implemented according to Plutus specification and work on JVM and JavaScript platforms.
Here are Scala sources that implement v1/v2 builtins for both JVM and JavaScript platforms:
https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.2/shared/src/main/scala/scalus/uplc/Builtin.scala
https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.2/shared/src/main/scala/scalus/builtin/Builtins.scala
Here is JVM platfrom specific code:
https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.2/jvm/src/main/scala/scalus/builtin/PlatformSpecific.scala
And here is JavaScript platform specific code:
https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.2/js/src/main/scala/scalus/builtin/PlatformSpecific.scala
Script Execution Budget calculation
Here are Script Execution Budget calculation implementation files. These are common for JVM/JavaScript platforms:
https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.2/shared/src/main/scala/scalus/uplc/eval/BuiltinCostModel.scala
https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.2/shared/src/main/scala/scalus/uplc/eval/CostModel.scala
https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.2/shared/src/main/scala/scalus/uplc/eval/MemoryUsage.scala
This are the tests that use Plutus Conformance Test files and run Scalus implementation of Plutus CEK machine and check agains their expected values:
https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/master/shared/src/test/scala/scalus/uplc/eval/PlutusConformanceSpec.scala
https://github.com/IntersectMBO/plutus/tree/master/plutus-conformance
The Plutus Conformance tests also contain expected execution budgets, like here:
https://github.com/IntersectMBO/plutus/blob/master/plutus-conformance/test-cases/uplc/evaluation/builtin/semantics/addInteger/addInteger1/addInteger1.uplc.budget.expected
You may see here that Scalus tests also check that the execution budgets match:
https://github.com/nau/scalus/b

ms.promise:
Scalus as a Scala Native library.
C API headers for Plutus script cost calculation and evaluation.
Documentation for the Native API.
Changelog.md and Readme.md files updated with details on what was implemented and how to use it.
ms.criteria:
Scalus sub-project that does Plutus script evaluation and execution cost calculation is a Scala Native library.
All the Plutus builtins, evaluation, cost calculation and their respective tests work as a native (LLVM) code and can be run natively.
C API headers contain all required definitions to perform Plutus script cost calculation and evaluation using this library.
C API is documented.
Changelog.md and Readme.md files updated with details on what was implemented and how to use it
ms.report:
Scala Native
・Native code (LLVM) support implementation is on the GitHub of the project.

・I've added a Scala Native compilation to Scalus build: https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/07a915f535d761389b10d9fd548f14164be21264/build.sbt#L169 so now all Scalus code is cross-compiled to JVM, JavaScript and LLVM/native platforms.
・I've created a Scalus Native C bindings that export functions required for script evaluation and budget calculation: https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.5/native/src/main/scala/scalus/uplc/eval/LibScalus.scala 
・all tests are successfully run on all 3 platforms: https://github.com/nau/scalus/actions/runs/13355578669/job/37297813156#step:6:2566

C API 
・C API headers are on the GitHub of the project.

・I've added a C header file with exported Scalus native functions:https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.5/examples-native/scalus.h
・C API is fairly documented
・I've created an example of a C program that evaluates Plutus scripts using the exported Scalus functions: https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.5/examples-native/main.c along with a Makefile that builds and runs it: https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.8.5/examples-native/Makefile

Documentation
Changelog.md mentions Scala Native implementation and Readme.md has a section about Scala Native and how to use it.
